releaseNotes: Eclipse Companion 1.1.5 introduces two complete visual themes: Solar Atlas, a bright daylight-first experience and the new default, and Eclipse Nocturne, a cinematic dark experience. Each theme has its own photography, surfaces, typography, navigation, controls and Android status-bar styling. Theme choice is saved between launches. Responsive layouts and automated checks cover phones, landscape, tablets and desktop. Existing astronomy, eclipse planning, learning, simulator, camera guidance, viewing safety and offline features remain included.
